text:
incident-bot: PAGER: KVCache memory + batch-scheduler tail-latency alert (us-east-1) — p99 generation latency > 2s, error rate spike. Paging Alex (oncall). /cc @channel :rotating_light:

Alex Gonzalez: I'm on it. Seeing the PD page. Any quick summary?

Priya Rao: Alert started ~2026-03-15T11:23:10Z. Metrics: kv_cache_size up ~3x, continuous_batching queues showing long-hold times (~250ms per request) and queue length growth. Batch scheduler p99 spiking to ~2.4s, p50 ok. Hypothesis: a regression in KV cache eviction + a set of long-running model calls (rerank/long-trace) occupying batches -> starvation for short chat/assistant requests.

Alex Gonzalez: Good hypothesis. Priya, can you paste the logs / key traces?

Priya Rao: Pasting excerpt from runtime logs where we see continuous-batch worker stall and repeated large KV cache writes:

```
[11:23:05] runtime.batch: start_batch id=0x7f9f size=64 expected=8
[11:23:07] kvcache.store: key=prefix_hash_0x9a3 size=12MB action=write
[11:23:07] runtime.batch: hold_for_kv id=0x7f9f wait=180ms
[11:23:08] runtime.batch: finish_batch id=0x7f9f latency=2100ms
[11:23:08] scheduler: short-queue wait=1243ms
```

Priya Rao: Also saw sudden spike in prefix growth after deploy 1762999 — eviction window seemed to be disabled by a feature flag flip.

Marco Liu: I pushed a quick diagnostic to mark long requests so they don't hold global batch slots. Prepared a config hotfix to bias scheduler fairness toward short requests and to temporarily disable continuous batching for the gen route. Canary prepared.

Samir Patel: Repro steps I ran locally: run a mix of 80% short chat (<=64 tokens) + 20% long rerank calls; if continuous batching not bounded, long ones monopolize. Repro snippet: 
```
ab -n 1000 -c 50 -p payload_long.json http://internal/generate
ab -n 1000 -c 50 -p payload_short.json http://internal/generate
```

Alex Gonzalez: Ok plan: 1) Apply scheduler fairness patch to canary group (10% nodes) 2) Toggle continuous_batching.enabled=false on canary for gen route 3) Evict oversized KV cache prefixes (safely) 4) Monitor error/latency and then roll forward cluster-wide. Any objections?

Janet O'Neil: +1. Also we need customer impact note for CS. Rebecca, can you draft a short blurb and flag customers with heavy short-request workload?

Rebecca Chen: On it. Early note: AcmeMaps and BetaCorp have elevated errors. I'll send an interim PSR once we confirm mitigation.

Marco Liu: Applying canary fairness patch now. Patch contents (k8s config snippet):
```
- name: batch_scheduler
  value: |
    fairness:
      enabled: true
      priority_weights:
        short: 3
        long: 1
    max_batch_time_ms: 5
    max_batch_size: 32
```

Marco Liu: canary rollout started to nodepool gen-canary-1 (10%); warming up.

ops-bot: deploy-gen-canary-1:success nodepool=gen-canary-1 image=runtime:v2026.3.15-hotfix

Priya Rao: Canary looks promising — p99 reduced from 2.4s -> 420ms on canary, kv_cache_size on canary nodes not growing. Short-queue wait dropped to ~80ms.

Alex Gonzalez: Good. Next: disable continuous batching on canary for gen route. Marco?

Marco Liu: Done: `feature.toggle.continuous_batching.gen=false` applied to canary. Observed immediate drop in long-hold events.

Samir Patel: While canary stabilizes, I'll run a safe eviction for oversized prefixes: `kvctl evict --pattern prefix_hash_* --older-than 1h --dry-run` then actual evict.

Priya Rao: Dry run shows ~120 prefixes > 8MB; evicting should free ~1.2GB per node. I'm ready to evict on canary nodes, then on full cluster after rollback window.

Alex Gonzalez: Go ahead on canary. Tag me.

Samir Patel: Eviction started on canary. ops-bot: eviction-job-canary:started

ops-bot: eviction-job-canary:success freed=1.14GB nodepool=gen-canary-1

Priya Rao: Post-eviction metrics on canary: kv_cache_size back to baseline, p99 remains ~430ms. Error-rate down to baseline.

Alex Gonzalez: Consensus: apply changes cluster-wide. I'm going to handoff soon (20m) to Janet — if anything escalates, page me. Janet, you'll be incident lead for the rollout.

Janet O'Neil: I accept. Peter (note: different shift) ping if you need me. Proceed with cluster-wide rollout of fairness patch + continuous_batching toggle + eviction.

Marco Liu: Rolling to remaining nodepools (region us-east-1 primary) now. ops-bot: batch-config-rollout:start image=runtime:v2026.3.15-hotfix

ops-bot: batch-config-rollout:progress 50%

Priya Rao: Observing telemetry during rollout: p99 across cluster trending down to ~500ms. Some nodes show transient 300-400ms spikes during eviction but recover quickly. No increase in 5xx.

Alex Gonzalez: Rebecca, CS update?

Rebecca Chen: Draft for customers: "We've identified a runtime regression that caused KV cache growth and the batch scheduler to favor long-running requests, leading to increased latency for short requests. We've rolled a hotfix that restores scheduler fairness, temporarily disables continuous batching for generation, and safely evicted oversized cache prefixes. Most customers should see improved latencies within minutes. We're monitoring and will follow up with a detailed report." Sending to AcmeMaps + BetaCorp now.

Rebecca Chen: (sent) AcmeMaps support ticket #34521 updated, BetaCorp #34602 updated. Both acknowledged receipt.

ops-bot: batch-config-rollout:complete duration=00:07:12 result=success

Priya Rao: All done. Cluster-wide p99 now ~480ms (was 2.4s). Error-rate normalized. Marking incident as mitigated.

Alex Gonzalez: Moving severity P1 -> P2 (mitigated but still monitoring). Creating short incident timeline and action items.

Janet O'Neil: Handoff notes: I'm on-call until 03:00 UTC, monitoring dashboards. If p99 creeps >700ms or kv_cache growth resumes, page me.

Alex Gonzalez: Action items I recorded: 1) Revert the feature flag flip that disabled eviction in dev pipeline and add gate 2) Add e2e test mix for long/short fairness to CI 3) Add alert for kv_cache_size DER (rate-of-change) and for queue-hold-time >150ms 4) Postmortem and RCA to follow. Assigning owners: Priya (RCA), Marco (scheduler safety), Samir (eviction tooling), Rebecca (customer comms).

Priya Rao: I'll own RCA, aiming for draft in 48h. Preliminary root cause: accidental feature flag propagation that set eviction.window=0 in a subset of runtime bundles + lack of scheduler priority for mixed workloads.

Samir Patel: Adding a safe-guard to `kvctl evict` to auto-detect growth patterns and alert before full blowup.

Rebecca Chen: I'll follow up with customers with ETA for postmortem.

Alex Gonzalez: Thanks team. Closing incident thread after a monitoring window. If anything regresses reopen and page. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-1768123456: status=mitigated closed_by=Alex Gonzalez

Janet O'Neil: Quick note for postmortem — we should simulate mixed traffic (small chat bursts + large reranks) in load tests weekly.

Priya Rao: Agreed. Also adding a small perf test harness to detect KV prefix growth regressions during deploys.

Alex Gonzalez: Logging off for now. Great work.
